summary: Phase 5: cross-session analytics + taper mode. Added a pure analytics module (engine/analytics.ts) with `sessionTrend`, `cueTrend`, `cueAggregate`, `compareSessions`, `pickTaperCues`, and `buildTaperProfileBlueprint` — every public helper unit-tested. Extracted `best10AvgOf` and `correctGoTimesOf` into engine/drill.ts as the single source of truth for both metrics, and refactored `cueBreakdown` to call them (closing the DRY hole architecture-red-team flagged in the memo). New Dexie helper `listRepsForSessions` bulk-fetches reps grouped by sessionId via the existing reps.sessionId index — no schema bump. New AnalyticsScreen with a loading state, empty state, per-session trend table with four inline-SVG sparklines (Avg RT, Best-10 RT, FS rate, Hes rate), a per-cue table with RT-trend sparkline, and a compare section with default baseline=second-most-recent / candidate=most-recent. compareSessions returns one of four explicit classifications per cue (`both_measured`, `both_error_only`, `candidate_only`, `baseline_only`) — the `both_error_only` row renders red so a was-fine-now-broken regression cannot hide behind a null RT. `deltaScore` returns null when the two sessions used different scoreWeights. Taper-mode builder in SettingsScreen runs on the last 5 sessions, requires ≥5 reps per cue across ≥2 sessions for eligibility, splits the K picks 70/30 between a go-pool (sorted by RT+errorRate weakness) and a no-go-pool (sorted by errorRate weakness), and creates a profile with rounds=3, workMs=60s, restMs=30s, maxReps=null, allowedCueIds=picked. 24 new tests (105 total, all green); typecheck, lint, vite build all clean. Reviewer APPROVED on first pass with non-blocking observations; the cheap ones (extract correctGoTimesOf, drop dead `kind` prop, tighten test comment, document weightsDiffer limited-domain quirk) were applied before approval. qa-playwright PASS on all 6 Phase 5 criteria + Phase 4 regression with zero console errors; full evidence in artifacts/phase5-verify/.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Taper mode profile: short rounds, low total volume, only the cues you are slowest or least accurate on
acceptance_criteria.verified_by: qa-playwright C5 — 'Build taper profile' in Settings → Taper mode produced profile 'Taper — 2026-05-26' with rounds=3, workMs=60_000, restMs=30_000, allowedCueIds=[lifts_lead_leg, drops_lead_hand, no_go_bait]; banner shows 'slowest go cues: …  weakest no-go cues: …'. analytics.test.ts > buildTaperProfileBlueprint asserts the blueprint shape and that user thresholds carry forward

qa-playwright C6 — Compare section in Analytics screen with baseline/candidate <select>s defaulting to (second-most-recent, most-recent), delta-stats panel (Δ Avg RT · Δ Score · Δ FS rate · Δ Hes rate, sign-color-coded), and a per-cue compare table with classification labels. analytics.test.ts > compareSessions asserts all four classifications + weights-differ deltaScore=null

gates.testing: 105/105 vitest tests pass (was 81 at Phase 4 boundary; 24 new across analytics, db, and drill suites). Every new public behavior has a primary-path + edge-case test, including the four compareSessions classifications, both ≥5-reps and ≥2-sessions eligibility floors, ties broken by cueId, fallback when one weakness pool is empty, and weights-differ → deltaScore null.
gates.dry: best10AvgOf and correctGoTimesOf are now both exported from engine/drill.ts and reused from analytics.ts at every call site (3 best10 sites + 4 correctGo sites). cueBreakdown was refactored to call the same helpers. Architecture-red-team explicitly flagged the best-10 inlining as a 'three-near-duplicate' risk; the extraction closes it. SettingsScreen handleBuildTaperProfile delegates blueprint assembly to the pure buildTaperProfileBlueprint helper rather than re-implementing the rule.
gates.drift: No Phase 1/2/3/4 schema or invariant touched. RepRecord / SessionRecord unchanged. Dexie version still v3. Older sessions render in the trend view because analytics reads only fields present since Phase 1 (cueId, result, reactionMs, sessionId). Phase 4 per-cue summary + anti-rhythm narrative still render after the drill.ts refactor (qa-playwright Phase 4 regression PASS).
gates.planning: decision-memo.md rewritten for Phase 5; planning gate triggered by cross-layer change (storage query + analytics + UI + profile generator). architecture-red-team flagged 3 blocking concerns (no-go weakness scoring, best-10 single source of truth, compareSessions null taxonomy) — all addressed in the memo BEFORE implementation and verified in tests.
gates.verification_sprint: Re-ran lint + tsc + 81/81 tests at the Phase 4 boundary before any Phase 5 code was added. Phase 4 qa-playwright regression also re-run during Phase 5 QA and passed (profile CRUD, per-cue summary, rhythm narrative).
gates.pre_commit_verify: scripts/phasekit-verify.sh runs lint + typecheck + tests; gate intact since Phase 1. vite build also clean (341 KB JS / 105 KB gzip, +5 KB vs Phase 4 boundary).

review.architecture_red_team: Flagged 3 blocking concerns pre-implementation: (a) no-go cues silently downweighted by a single weakness score, (b) best-10 inlined in cueBreakdown — three-near-duplicate risk, (c) compareSessions null handling collapsing four distinct cases. All resolved in the memo and verified by dedicated tests before any UI code was written.
review.code_reviewer: APPROVE on first pass — no blocking concerns. 6 non-blocking observations; cheap ones applied: extracted correctGoTimesOf alongside best10AvgOf, dropped dead `kind` prop from Spark, tightened the pickTaperCues fixture comment, documented the weightsDifferBetween limited-domain quirk inline.
review.qa_playwright: PASS — all 6 Phase 5 criteria + Phase 4 regression. Zero console errors observed during the full driver run. Evidence in artifacts/phase5-verify/ (verify-phase5.mjs, results.json, verify-run.log, 7 PNG screenshots, vite-tail.log).
